name: Decree
overview: The biblical concept of decree reveals God's sovereign authority to establish and fulfill His promises, as seen in His unchanging word that will not fail (Numbers 23:19) and His declaration of blessing upon Abraham's seed (Genesis 26:4). Decrees are also linked to obedience and love toward God, which result in blessing and prosperity (Deuteronomy 10:12; 30:16). Furthermore, the power of decree extends to the believer's life, where declaring a matter in alignment with God's will leads to establishment and guidance (Job 22:28), exemplified supremely in the divine decree affirming the Sonship of Christ (Psalms 2:7).
